summary: Retested the iteration 330 fixes for onboarding / Import Centre, plus the new stale-worker recovery, async rollback and discard. The review request text was truncated, so the scope comes from the f71bc451 diff and the iteration 330 action items. REGRESSION: test_onboarding_consolidation + _independent pass 15/15; test_sage_sicon_customer_import + _independent pass 20/20. NEW suite test_onboarding_fixes_iter331.py: 8/14 pass, 6 fail on real bugs. WORKING: stale committing/analysing/rolling_back jobs flip to interrupted/analysis_failed after 180s, and a fresh job is left alone. Scenario 9 works: a worker killed after writing an org but before marking the row done goes stale, Retry creates no duplicate (3 orgs and 3 refs for 3 accounts), and Undo then removes all 3. Discard works: analysed → discarded, then discard/commit/approve/rollback all return 409, a completed job can't be discarded, and a discarded job is not in the Review Centre. Async rollback works: two concurrent rollbacks return 200+409, the job reaches rolled_back, orgs and refs are removed. A packet with an account number claims it, and a second packet with the same ref gets 409. The master-admin create race is fixed (verified by the iteration 330 test, now passing). Manual entry with a new account number returns similar_customers. Duplicate scoring (same postcode + a shared word) works. UI: Onboarding → Import Centre → Customer Accounts. Manual entry with an existing name plus a new account number shows the amber 'similar existing customers' note. Upload a Sage CSV → Discard → 'Discarded — nothing was imported' and the Approve/Run buttons disappear. Upload → Approve → Run → 'Import complete · 2 new LITE organisations' → Undo (confirm dialog) → 'Rolled back' and the history list refreshes; DB check: 0 orgs left.

critical.endpoint: utils/customer_identity.claim_ref + provision_customer_org (used by POST /customer-import/manual, Sage commit, Aftersales estate)
critical.issue: A customer_account_refs row left pointing at a DELETED org breaks creation. find_orgs_by_ref now filters to live orgs and returns [], but claim_ref then hits DuplicateKeyError and returns the DEAD org id. Effects: (a) POST /customer-import/manual with that account number returns 500 (AttributeError on NoneType: line 1059 find_one returns None, then out['similar_customers']). (b) POST /master-admin/organizations returns 409 'Account X already belongs to an existing customer' when no live customer has it. (c) Sage analyze returns analysis_failed: _evaluate_sage line ~275 does ex = find_one(ids[0]) → None → _org_changes(None) raises AttributeError, because the evaluator's ref map is not live-filtered. Leftover refs come from: packet _rollback_provisioning (claims the ref before insert but never deletes it on failure), org-cleanup merge-delete, test-data purge and MOD estate delete (none of them touch customer_account_refs). Fix: in claim_ref, when the existing owner org no longer exists, replace it atomically (find_one_and_update where org_id == dead); also apply the live filter in _evaluate_sage; release refs in _rollback_provisioning and the org delete paths.

_job_view maps a stale 'rolling_back' to 'interrupted', the same status as an interrupted commit. commit() accepts 'interrupted', so the UI shows 'Import interrupted — retry to continue' and 'Retry failed records'. Retry flips a half-undone import back to 'completed': all rows are still commit_status=done, so nothing is re-written. The job then says it is complete while its orgs were partly deleted. Reproduced: fake rolling_back job (stale) → GET returns interrupted → POST commit returns 200 → completed. Fix: use a separate status (e.g. 'rollback_interrupted') that only allows rollback again, and show 'Undo interrupted — run Undo again' in ImportJobPanel.

The guard never fires. _create_organization line 504 calls CI.duplicate_suggestions(org.get('name',''), org.get('postcode','')), but packet organisation blocks only have legal_name / trading_name / billing_postcode. Both arguments are always '' and the function returns []. Reproduced: an existing org 'TEST_PkXXXX Fitness' and a packet with the same legal/trading name provisioned with 200 and no confirm, creating a duplicate customer. The new UI window.confirm path (?confirm_new_customer=true) can therefore never be reached. Fix: duplicate_suggestions(org.get('trading_name') or org.get('legal_name'), org.get('billing_postcode')).

minor.issue: Changing an org's ref from R1 to R2 claims R2 but never releases R1, so A owns both in customer_account_refs. Another org then can't take R1 (409 'already belongs to another customer'). The org's sage_account_refs is also not updated (stays [] while customer_account_number=R2). sage_customer_number edits bypass the identity service entirely.

No try/except, and heartbeat_at is never refreshed during the rollback. An exception leaves the job 'rolling_back' until the 180s stale check. A long rollback (e.g. 5,000 rows) that takes over 180s is flipped to 'interrupted' while still running, which allows a second Undo or a Retry to run at the same time. Refresh the heartbeat every N undo entries and wrap the body in try/except that sets an explicit failure status.

The stale-flip only happens inside _job_view (single-job GET). Lists and history still show a dead job as 'committing' until someone opens it. Verified with a fake stale job: both the list and history returned 'committing'.
The response that performs the flip doesn't include the new 'error' message: only job['status'] is updated in memory. The next GET does include it.

Sets status=then unconditionally at the end. If a stale analysing job was flipped to analysis_failed and then discarded, a late-finishing worker overwrites 'discarded' with 'analysed'. Use a conditional update (status == 'analysing').
After a retry the results count the re-linked row as org_unchanged rather than org_created_lite (2 created / 1 unchanged for 3 new orgs). The report under-counts what the import created.

ui_bugs.issue: After Discard, the job panel shows 'Discarded' but the history list below still shows the job as 'analysed' until a reload. Undo does refresh it (onDone); discard doesn't.
After Undo the row outcome badges still say 'imported' under the 'Rolled back' status.

A rollback interrupted by a worker restart is shown as 'Import interrupted — retry to continue' with a 'Retry failed records' button (see the backend critical item). It should show 'Undo interrupted' and offer only Undo.

integration_issues.issue: Can't be reached because the backend similar-name guard never fires (wrong field names).

action_items: claim_ref: when the existing owner org no longer exists, take over the ref atomically. Apply the live-org filter in _evaluate_sage's ref map (the analysis crashes on None). Guard manual_customer against a None org (500). Release refs in onboarding_packets._rollback_provisioning, org-cleanup merge-delete, test-data purge and MOD estate deletes.
Give an interrupted rollback its own status (not 'interrupted') so commit/Retry is refused (409) and the UI offers only 'Undo again'.
onboarding_packets._create_organization: call duplicate_suggestions(trading_name or legal_name, billing_postcode). Today the similar-name guard never runs.
PUT org details: when customer_account_number changes, delete the old customer_account_refs row for this org and update sage_account_refs.
_do_rollback: refresh heartbeat_at periodically; wrap in try/except that sets a terminal status. _evaluate_bg: make the final status update conditional on status=='analysing'.
Apply the stale-flip (or a stale indicator) in /jobs, /history and /review, not only in single-job GET.
UI: refresh the Previous-imports list after Discard. Show rows as rolled back after Undo.
critical_code_review_comments: customer_identity.find_orgs_by_ref now hides dead owners, but claim_ref still returns them, so the two disagree. Every caller that checks find_orgs_by_ref and then claims gets a dead id back (provision_customer_org returns (dead_id, False) → rows and contacts attach to a non-existent org).
master_admin_org_create claims the ref before insert_one. If the insert or a later step raises, the claim is orphaned and the ref is blocked permanently by the bug above.

STALE_SECONDS=180 with commit heartbeats only every BATCH=200 rows. If one batch (e.g. a slow Sicon direct read or a large Mongo write) takes over 180s, Retry can run concurrently with a live worker. Consider a per-row heartbeat or a worker lease id checked on each row write.
customer_account_import.py is 1,238 lines: split into evaluation, commit/rollback workers and the review/activation routes.

rca of the issue: Leftover ref: commit f71bc451 made find_orgs_by_ref ignore deleted orgs, but claim_ref (unique insert, DuplicateKeyError → return the existing owner) was not changed, so callers get a dead org id. Reproduce: insert customer_account_refs {system:'sage', company:'', ref:'LF1', org_id:'gone'}, then POST /customer-import/manual {name, account_ref:'LF1', confirm_new:true} → 500. Interrupted rollback: _job_view maps rolling_back → interrupted, and commit() accepts interrupted. Packet guard: wrong dict keys in _create_organization.
